map.name: Wendle Cross
map.setting: a crossroads inn and its hamlet
map.trouble: The warlock Zelloc raises the dead of an ancient battle at Fort Skarrow on the Grey Moor, and his Skeletons are shutting the four roads.

guard_bark.specifics: Brask stands guard at the door of Telmarq the Arch-Wizard's tower.

first.speaker: Brask
first.text: This is the tower of Telmarq the Arch-Wizard.

later.speaker: Brask
later.text: Looks like rain again. Good for the turnips, I suppose.

bounty_offer.specifics: Haddrick the Toll Keeper pays to have the bears driven from the beech wood that shuts the south road; he pays with a hunter's bow.

offer.speaker: Haddrick
offer.text: Good day. I take it you have come about the notice on my door? The bears in the beech wood, south of the crossroads past the old well, have become a public menace! Half the pigs in the hamlet are eaten and no cart will come up the south road. The Toll House is authorised to pay for the expungement of the bears. If you could drive them off, I would give you a very fine bow.

reminder.speaker: Haddrick
reminder.text: No carts, no tolls! Please do something about those bears.

completion.speaker: Haddrick
completion.text:
Splendid! Most splendid! The south road is open again, and the carts will be rolling by morning!

Here is the bow, as promised. A traveling hunter paid his toll with it last spring. He swore it once shot down a dragon. I don't believe a word of it, but it is a very good bow.

journal.text: Drive the bears out of the beech wood for Haddrick the Toll Keeper.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Lord Belgrin, an old gentleman, wants back the enchanted Lantern the Imps stole from his house in the night.

offer.speaker: Belgrin
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer. You find me in a most deplorable predicament. In the dead of night a horde of malodorous Imps invaded my house and purloined my enchanted Lantern! Without it I cannot find my own door after sundown. If you could get it back, you would save an old man a great deal of misery. Will you undertake this task?

refusal.speaker: Belgrin
refusal.text: Then I shall bear the darkness alone. Good day to you.

reminder.speaker: Belgrin
reminder.text: Have you no news of my Lantern? Someone saw the Imps flitting about the old lime kiln at dusk. Make haste!

completion.speaker: Belgrin
completion.text: My Lantern! You have recovered it! I am in your debt, kind sir. Here are 100 gold pieces, a modest recompense for your valor.

after.speaker: Belgrin
after.text: My thanks again, Wanderer. My door is always open to you.

journal.text: Recover Lord Belgrin's enchanted Lantern from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Lord Belgrin's enchanted Lantern from the Imps.

rumour.specifics: Three folk of Wendle Cross: Hesta points to the inn, Fenna repeats Rudd's news of Skeletons, Mungo grumbles about the stables.

rumour1.speaker: Hesta
rumour1.text: If it's news you want, go to the Crooked Kettle. Odo hears everything that comes down the four roads.

rumour2.speaker: Fenna
rumour2.text: Did you hear? Skeletons on the Grey Moor again last night! Rudd saw them himself!

rumour3.speaker: Mungo
rumour3.text: Whose bright idea was it to build the new stables on top of the old graveyard? Now the horses won't go in at all!

shop_greeting.specifics: Odo of the Crooked Kettle inn, Grimsel the smith, Quimby of Quimby's Potions and Notions.

inn.speaker: Odo
inn.text: Welcome to the Crooked Kettle! Prices went up a bit since the roads closed. Can't be helped, friend!

arms.speaker: Grimsel
arms.text: What now? Half the hamlet wants a sword mended today. Buy something or get out of my light.

magic.speaker: Quimby
magic.text: Ooh, you're new around here! I can always tell -- you've still got both your eyebrows! Welcome to Quimby's Potions and Notions!

two_givers.specifics: Ambrus, a fussy scholar, wants the Book of Old Roads fetched from the chapel crypt for Telmarq; Warden Holk wants Grubbin the Grave-Robber back, dead or alive.

offer_a.speaker: Ambrus
offer_a.text:
Oh, botheration! Telmarq's sent someone after his book again?!

Very well, very well. When the Skeletons came up out of the chapel crypt I ran, and I left the Book of Old Roads down there on the reading stand. Telmarq says he can't find the way into Fort Skarrow without it. If you could get it back, you'd save my good name. Here, take this iron key. It opens the crypt door behind the chapel.

offer_b.speaker: Holk
offer_b.text: Wanted, dead or alive! Grubbin the Grave-Robber dug himself out of my cell last night. That wretch has been selling our dead to Zelloc by the cartload. He's hiding out on the Grey Moor somewhere. Bring him back alive and it's 100 gold. Dead, 50. Makes no difference to me, stranger.

outcome_a.speaker: Ambrus
outcome_a.text: My Book! Not a page torn! Oh, thank goodness. Telmarq shall have it tonight. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.

outcome_b.speaker: Holk
outcome_b.text: Grubbin! Back in my cell where he belongs! Here's your 100 gold, as I promised. This time I'll chain him to the wall.

journal_a.text: Recover the Book of Old Roads from the chapel crypt for Ambrus.

journal_b.text: Bring Grubbin the Grave-Robber to Warden Holk, dead or alive.

rescue.specifics: Gorsk's quarrymen hid in the tunnels under the old quarry when the Skeletons came up; he gives the key to the west gate for them.

plea.speaker: Gorsk
plea.text: Yaaahh! Stay back! I've got a shovel and I'll use it!... Oh. You're no Skeleton. Thank goodness! The Skeletons came up out of the old quarry north of the Crooked Kettle and my lads ran down into the tunnels to hide. They're still down there! I'll tell you what, bring my men out safe and you can have my key to the west gate. It's the quickest way onto the Grey Moor.

reminder.speaker: Gorsk
reminder.text: My poor lads! Are they still down there? Hurry!

found.speaker: Quarryman
found.text: Someone's come for us! Up, lads, up! We're going home!

following.speaker: Quarryman
following.text: Not the left tunnel! That's where the Skeletons came from. Take the right one, past the old cart.

completion.speaker: Gorsk
completion.text: My lads! You brought them all back! Here's the key to the west gate, as I promised. Now go and see Telmarq at his tower. He's been asking after you.

journal.text: Rescue the quarrymen trapped in the tunnels under the old quarry.

main_opening.specifics: Rudd points the player to Telmarq the Arch-Wizard, an old friend of Pellam the Caravan Master, who gives him spell scrolls and sends him after the warlock Zelloc at Fort Skarrow.

herald.speaker: Rudd
herald.text: There were Skeletons on the Grey Moor again last night! Telmarq the Arch-Wizard wants you up at his tower right away.

opening.speaker: Telmarq
opening.text:
So! You are the one Pellam wrote to me about. Come in, come in, lad. I had begun to fear Zelloc's Skeletons had got you on the road.

Hear me well. Zelloc is a warlock of the foulest sort. He has taken old Fort Skarrow, out on the Grey Moor, and there he raises the dead of an ancient battle. Every night his army grows. Already the north road is lost, and if he is not stopped Wendle Cross will be the next to fall!

I am too old for such a journey, more's the pity. Take these spell scrolls, they are the best I have. Cross the Grey Moor, find Fort Skarrow and put an end to Zelloc's abominable work. Go now, and may the stars watch over you!

reminder.speaker: Telmarq
reminder.text: Why do you dawdle? Zelloc's army grows with every night!

journal.text: Find Fort Skarrow on the Grey Moor and stop the warlock Zelloc.
